explanation: It is 0 except at the GO step when the agent chooses a2 right after an unrewarded trial, mostly late in the episode (around trial 60 to 90): it is highest (9-10) when that previous trial was a2 leading rarely to S1 after a run of rewarded a2 trials, middling (2-6) after an unrewarded common a2 trial or when unrewarded trials have already piled up, and 0 at D1, at D2, on a1 choices, after rewarded trials, and before about trial 50.
